subsidiesCatalog.name: PMEGP Capital Subsidy (Margin Money Scheme)
subsidiesCatalog.benefit: 15% to 35% Capital Subsidy on Project Cost
subsidiesCatalog.eligibilityBasis: Eligible: Manufacturing unit with project investment <= ₹50 Lakh under PMEGP norms

subsidiesCatalog.name: CGTMSE Collateral-Free Credit Guarantee
subsidiesCatalog.benefit: Up to 85% Credit Guarantee Cover (No Collateral up to ₹5 Cr)
subsidiesCatalog.eligibilityBasis: Eligible: MSME credit facility <= ₹5 Crore under CGTMSE Trust rules

subsidiesCatalog.name: State Industrial Policy Interest & Power Subsidy
subsidiesCatalog.benefit: 5% to 7% Interest Subsidy for 5 Years + Industrial Electricity Duty Exemption
subsidiesCatalog.eligibilityBasis: Eligible: State Industrial Policy concessions on term loan & industrial power tariff

subsidiesCatalog.name: ZED Certification & Clean Technology Subsidy
subsidiesCatalog.benefit: Up to 80% Subsidy on Clean Tech, Energy Audits & ZED Certification
subsidiesCatalog.eligibilityBasis: Eligible: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) green process compliance

subsidiesCatalog.name: PLI Scheme & Sectoral Capital Subsidy (Atmanirbhar Bharat)
subsidiesCatalog.benefit: 4% to 6% Incentive on Incremental Sales / Up to 25% Capex Subsidy
subsidiesCatalog.eligibilityBasis: Eligible: Priority sector with capital investment >= ₹50 Lakh under National PLI / Capital Subsidy Policy
